title: Let admins see a customer's orders
description: Support needs a customer's order history when they call. Adds GET /api/admin/users/:id/orders for admins, newest first. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The tests share the admin token and customer created in the first test, and the database is reset only once (`beforeAll`), so each later test depends on the ones before it: run alone (`-t`, `.only`) or in another order they fail, and one failure cascades. Create what each test needs in `beforeEach`.
